# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import airflow
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.models import Variable
from airflow.sensors.external_task import ExternalTaskSensor
from airflow.sensors.sql_sensor import SqlSensor
from airflow.operators.bash_operator import BashOperator
from airflow.operators.python_operator import BranchPythonOperator
from airflow.operators.dagrun_operator import TriggerDagRunOperator
from airflow.operators.dummy_operator import DummyOperator
from airflow.api.common.experimental.pool import get_pool, create_pool
from airflow.exceptions import PoolNotFound
from airflow.models import BaseOperator
from airflow.operators.dummy_operator import DummyOperator
from airflow.operators.python_operator import PythonOperator
import botocore
import boto3
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import pendulum

try:
    Email_receiver = Variable.get("Email_receiver")
except KeyError:
    Email_receiver = "not-set@domain.com"


class CreatePoolOperator(BaseOperator):
    ui_color = '#b8e9ee'

    def __init__(
            self,
            name,
            slots,
            description='',
            *args, **kwargs):
        super(CreatePoolOperator, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.description = description
        self.slots = slots
        self.name = name

    def execute(self, context):
        try:
            pool = get_pool(name=self.name)
            print('Pool exists: %s'%(pool))
        except PoolNotFound:
            # create the pool
            pool = create_pool(name=self.name, slots=self.slots, description=self.description)
            print('Pool exists: %s'%(pool))


local_tz = pendulum.timezone("UTC")

def printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = False):
    errorFound = False

    if startWithNewline == True:
        findPattern = "\nERROR"
    else:
        findPattern = "ERROR"

    try:
        print(event['message'], end="")
        if event['message'].find(findPattern) != -1:
            errorFound = True
            print(event)
    except:
        print(event)
        if str(event).find(findPattern) != -1:
            errorFound = True

    return errorFound


def startDBImportExecution(command, instanceID):

    ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm',region_name='eu-west-1')
    logs_client = boto3.client('logs',region_name='eu-west-1')

    commandPath = "sudo -iu dbimport /usr/local/dbimport/"
    command = "%sbin/%s || echo ERROR; sleep 1"%(commandPath, command)
    cloudWatchLogGroupName = "dbimport"
    errorFound = False


    # Start the import by the help of SSM Send Command
    sendCommand_response = ssm_client.send_command(
        InstanceIds=[instanceID],
        DocumentName="AWS-RunShellScript",
        Parameters={'commands': [command], 'executionTimeout': ['172800']},
        CloudWatchOutputConfig={'CloudWatchLogGroupName': cloudWatchLogGroupName, 'CloudWatchOutputEnabled': True}
        )


    # Get the commandID and set the logStreamName for CloudWatch
    commandID = sendCommand_response['Command']['CommandId']
    logStreamNameStdOut = "%s/%s/aws-runShellScript/stdout"%(commandID, instanceID)
    logStreamNameStdErr = "%s/%s/aws-runShellScript/stderr"%(commandID, instanceID)

    print('')
    print('CloudWatch logs is available at:')
    print(logStreamNameStdOut)
    print(logStreamNameStdErr)
    print('')


    # Run a loop until the command is actually running
    commandRunning = False
    while commandRunning == False:
        try:
            commandInvocation_response = ssm_client.get_command_invocation(
                CommandId=commandID,
                InstanceId=instanceID
                )
            commandStatus = commandInvocation_response['Status']

            if commandStatus in ('InProgress', 'Success'):
                commandRunning = True
            elif commandStatus in ('Pending', 'Delayed'):
                commandRunning = False
            elif commandStatus in ('DeliveryTimedOut', 'ExecutionTimedOut', 'Failed', 'Cancelled', 'Undeliverable', 'Terminated', 'InvalidPlatform', 'AccessDenied'):
                raise

        except botocore.exceptions.ClientError as err:
            if err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'InvocationDoesNotExist':
                pass
            else:
                raise err

        time.sleep(5)

    # Start fetching log from CloudWatch. Initial fetch will be from head and also fetch the token for upcomming messages
    nextTokenStdOut = None
    nextTokenStdErr = None
    logEventsRunning = False
    while logEventsRunning == False:
        try:
            responseStdOut = logs_client.get_log_events(
                logGroupName='dbimport',
                logStreamName=logStreamNameStdOut,
                startFromHead=True
                )

            for event in responseStdOut['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = False) == True:
                    errorFound = True

            nextTokenStdOut = responseStdOut['nextForwardToken']
            logEventsRunning = True

            responseStdErr = logs_client.get_log_events(
                logGroupName='dbimport',
                logStreamName=logStreamNameStdErr,
                startFromHead=True
                )

            nextTokenStdErr = responseStdErr['nextForwardToken']

            for event in responseStdErr['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = True) == True:
                    errorFound = True

        except botocore.exceptions.ClientError as err:
            if err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                pass
            elif err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ThrottlingException':
                pass
            else:
                print("DEBUG: %s"%(err.response['Error']['Code']))
                raise err


        time.sleep(1)

    if commandStatus == 'TimedOut':
        print('AWS SSM Send-command timeout!')
        errorFound = True

    # Loop while the command is running and print all messages from CloudWatch at the same time
    while commandStatus == 'InProgress':
        try:
            commandInvocation_response = ssm_client.get_command_invocation(
                CommandId=commandID,
                InstanceId=instanceID
                )

            commandStatus = commandInvocation_response['Status']

            if commandStatus == 'TimedOut':
                print('AWS SSM Send-command timeout!')
                errorFound = True
                break
            elif commandStatus != 'InProgress':
                break

            responseStdOut = logs_client.get_log_events(
                logGroupName='dbimport',
                logStreamName=logStreamNameStdOut,
                nextToken=nextTokenStdOut
                )

            nextTokenStdOut = responseStdOut['nextForwardToken']

            for event in responseStdOut['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = False) == True:
                    errorFound = True

            if nextTokenStdErr == None:
                responseStdErr = logs_client.get_log_events(
                    logGroupName='dbimport',
                    logStreamName=logStreamNameStdErr,
                    startFromHead=True
                    )
            else:
                responseStdErr = logs_client.get_log_events(
                    logGroupName='dbimport',
                    logStreamName=logStreamNameStdErr,
                    nextToken=nextTokenStdErr
                    )

            nextTokenStdErr = responseStdErr['nextForwardToken']

            for event in responseStdErr['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = True) == True:
                    errorFound = True

        except botocore.exceptions.ClientError as err:
            if err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                pass
            elif err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ThrottlingException':
                pass
            else:
                print("DEBUG: %s"%(err.response['Error']['Code']))
                raise err

        except UnboundLocalError:
            pass

        time.sleep(15)


    # Loop to get the last message and print in the output
    lastMessagePrinted = False
    while lastMessagePrinted == False:
        try:
            responseStdOut = logs_client.get_log_events(
                logGroupName='dbimport',
                logStreamName=logStreamNameStdOut,
                nextToken=nextTokenStdOut
                )

            nextTokenStdOut = responseStdOut['nextForwardToken']
            for event in responseStdOut['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = False) == True:
                    errorFound = True

            lastMessagePrinted = True

            if nextTokenStdErr == None:
                responseStdErr = logs_client.get_log_events(
                    logGroupName='dbimport',
                    logStreamName=logStreamNameStdErr,
                    startFromHead=True
                    )
            else:
                responseStdErr = logs_client.get_log_events(
                    logGroupName='dbimport',
                    logStreamName=logStreamNameStdErr,
                    nextToken=nextTokenStdErr
                    )

            nextTokenStdErr = responseStdErr['nextForwardToken']

            for event in responseStdErr['events']:
                if printAndFindEventErrors(event, startWithNewline = True) == True:
                    errorFound = True

        except botocore.exceptions.ClientError as err:
            if err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                pass
            elif err.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ThrottlingException':
                pass
            else:
                print("DEBUG: %s"%(err.response['Error']['Code']))
                raise err

        except UnboundLocalError:
            pass

        time.sleep(1)

    if errorFound == True:
        raise



default_args = {
    'owner': 'airflow',
    'depends_on_past': False,
    'start_date': datetime(2017, 1, 1, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz),
    'max_active_runs': 1,
    'email': Email_receiver,
    'email_on_failure': False,
    'email_on_retry': False,
    'retry_exponential_backoff': False,
    'retries': 0,
    'pool': 'DBImport_test',
    'retry_delay': timedelta(minutes=5),
}

dag = DAG(
    'DBImport_test',
    default_args=default_args,
    description='DBImport_test',
    catchup=False,
    schedule_interval=None)

start = PythonOperator(
    task_id='start',
    python_callable=startDBImportExecution,
    op_kwargs={"command": "manage --checkAirflowExecution --airflowDAG=DBImport_test", "instanceID": "i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

stop = PythonOperator(
    task_id='stop',
    python_callable=startDBImportExecution,
    op_kwargs={"command": "manage --checkAirflowExecution --airflowDAG=DBImport_test", "instanceID": "i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished = DummyOperator(
    task_id='before_tasks_finished',
    priority_weight=100,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    dag=dag)

events = PythonOperator(
    task_id='events',
    python_callable=startDBImportExecution,
    op_kwargs={"command": "import -d testdb -t events ", "instanceID": "i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},
    pool='i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished.set_downstream(events)
events.set_downstream(stop)

orders_clearStage = PythonOperator(
    task_id='orders_clearStage',
    python_callable=startDBImportExecution,
    op_kwargs={"command": "manage --clearImportStage -h testdb -t orders", "instanceID": "i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},
    pool='i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

orders = PythonOperator(
    task_id='orders',
    python_callable=startDBImportExecution,
    op_kwargs={"command": "import -d testdb -t orders ", "instanceID": "i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"},
    pool='i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    retries=5,
    dag=dag)

before_tasks_finished.set_downstream(orders_clearStage)
orders_clearStage.set_downstream(orders)
orders.set_downstream(stop)


createPool_DBImport_test = CreatePoolOperator(
    name='DBImport_test',
    slots=24,
    task_id='createPool_DBImport_test',
    retries=5,
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

start.set_downstream(createPool_DBImport_test)
createPool_DBImport_test.set_downstream(before_tasks_finished)


createPool_i_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx = CreatePoolOperator(
    name='i-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
    slots=24,
    task_id='createPool_i_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx',
    retries=5,
    priority_weight=1,
    weight_rule='absolute',
    pool=None,
    dag=dag)

start.set_downstream(createPool_i_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx)
createPool_i_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.set_downstream(before_tasks_finished)
